Functions grouped via roxygen @family tags — check @family tag function find siblings rather guessing filenames. Processing pipeline (stage hsi_calc_*/hsi_smooth_* function taking returning SpatRaster, chainable |>): hsi_calc_reflectance() — raw DN → reflectance white/dark references. Three calibration paths depending darkspec/tint (single-session, matched-darks (recommended), scaled-dark fallback); exact formulas roxygen @details §6.1. hsi_smooth_median() / hsi_smooth_savgol() — spectral smoothing. hsi_remove_continuum() — continuum removal. hsi_calc_rabd() / hsi_calc_raba() / hsi_calc_ndi() / hsi_calc_ratio() / hsi_calc_difference() / hsi_calc_remp() — spectral indices. spectral_indices data object (R/data.R) lookup table literature-defined index presets; columns map directly argument names corresponding hsi_calc_* function, row can spread directly call. hsi_extract_profile() / hsi_extract_spectrum() — pull spatial profiles per-pixel spectra processed raster. Wavelength addressing: band names SpatRaster canonical wavelength labels (numeric strings nm). wavelength_position() (utils.R) resolves requested wavelengths band indices nearest match shared primitive underneath hsi_subset(), hsi_subset_range(), index functions — read first working anything wavelength-related. Spatial calibration / co-registration toolchain (@family HSI Co-registration): hsi_calibration_from_scale() / hsi_calibration_from_dims() / hsi_calibration_direct() establish pixel--unit scaling; hsi_set_extent() / hsi_find_extent() / hsi_pixels_to_units() / hsi_drop_crs() manipulate georeferencing; hsi_check_gcp() → hsi_match_gcp() → hsi_coregister() ground-control-point workflow aligning one sensor’s raster another’s grid (GCPs embedded GDAL VRT, warped via sf::gdal_utils()). hsi_coregister() requires x file source disk — GDAL warps files, -memory rasters. title: HSItools 0.5.3
text: Breaking: hsi_bind_layers() longer exported (non-functional stub; design pending). Breaking: removed hsi_merge_rasters; use hsi_bind_rows instead. Added capture metadata sidecars: hsi_create_metadata(), hsi_write_metadata(), hsi_read_metadata(). One flat YAML file per capture, 32-field schema (v1.1.0), name required. Reader validates fields schema version read. package errors warnings now carry hsitools_error / hsitools_warning condition classes, can caught distinguished {terra}/GDAL base R conditions programmatically. Internal validation helpers (check_* family) unified; list inputs now report offending elements single error instead failing first. Fixed hsi_read_metadata() pointing wrong argument name filename validation errors. Added hsi_tiled() parallel tiled processing larger--memory rasters ({mirai} workers, VRT mosaic, automatic BIGTIFF outputs 4 GB). hsi_calc_reflectance now uses matched-dark formula independent white/target integration times. Added spatial calibration co-registration toolchain: hsi_calibration_from_scale, hsi_set_extent, hsi_find_extent, hsi_pixels_to_units, hsi_drop_crs, hsi_check_gcp, hsi_match_gcp, hsi_coregister. Added MNF: hsi_calc_mnf / hsi_apply_mnf. Continuous integration five platforms (Linux devel/release/oldrel, macOS, Windows) via GitHub Actions, including Quarto vignette builds (skipped Windows CI due upstream quarto limitation; verified platforms).
